0022600112.text: The Utah Jazz (0-1, 12th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Northwest) host the Los Angeles Lakers (1-0, 5th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific) in this regular season game, the Jazz's third of the 2026-27 season. Utah is without Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and Jake LaRavia (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 131-107 loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
